collections.title: Workflow validation
collections.question: Can a small matched long-read and paired-end short-read workflow complete?
collections.scientific_scope: Engineering fixtures, excluded from broad scientific conclusions.

collections.title: Matched real-input validation
collections.question: Does the same typed input interface admit a genuine local read subset and matched reference?
collections.scientific_scope: Explicit external validation fixture; not automatically executed by Quick.

collections.title: Native-genome simulated foundation
collections.question: How does recovery vary across native genomes and controlled error-free input recipes?
collections.scientific_scope: Five references and five sampling seeds; descriptive GC strata, not a causal GC experiment.

collections.title: Wick and Holt published long-read collection
collections.question: How do eligible long-read workflows recover the original published simulated datasets?
collections.scientific_scope: Frozen deposited Badread simulations; scientifically separate from newly generated targeted cases.

collections.title: Deposited real small-plasmid inputs
collections.question: How do workflows agree with matched polished references for deposited real reads?
collections.scientific_scope: Modern workflows on source-study deposited inputs; reference agreement is not independent error-free truth.

collections.title: Technical reproducibility validation
collections.question: Do three executions on exactly the same prepared long-read input agree?
collections.scientific_scope: One small engineering input; technical executions are not biological replicates.

scenarios.title: Plasmids
scenarios.question: How do native plasmid size and relative input depth affect recovery?

scenarios.title: GC and composition
scenarios.question: How does recovery vary across descriptive composition strata?

scenarios.title: Repeats and structure
scenarios.question: How do input span and native genome structure affect measured recovery?

scenarios.title: Read quality and sampling
scenarios.question: How do coverage and read-length recipes affect recovery?

scenarios.title: Reproducibility
scenarios.question: Do technically repeated or deliberately reordered inputs produce the same output?

datasets.title: Bacillus subtilis 168
datasets.description: First 200 kb of the published chromosome, a linear workflow fixture; not a whole-genome scientific panel.

datasets.title: Bacillus subtilis 168
datasets.description: Matched 200 kb linear validation reference; paired-end ART reads.

datasets.title: Escherichia coli ATCC 25922
datasets.description: Explicit externally supplied subset of genuine deposited ONT reads. Never generated or silently substituted. Same-BioSample reference is a comparator, not error-free real-isolate truth.
